raw_result.task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear any light objects from the kitchen surfaces and ensure the area is well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Tidy up the living room by removing light clutter and arranging items neatly.
central_instructions.R3: Organize the bedroom by moving heavy objects if necessary and ensuring everything is in order.
central_instructions.R4: Remove any light clutter from the bathroom surfaces and make sure the area is tidy.
